Requester.description: RPC Requester for sending requests and receiving replies via DDS.

parameters.service_name: String name of the service to connect to

send_request.description: Sends a request and returns a request_id for correlation with replies.
send_request.returns: A request_id object used with receive_replies()

receive_replies.description: Waits for replies correlated to a specific request_id.
receive_replies.returns: List of reply samples. Each sample has .info and .data attributes.
receive_replies.exception: Raises dds.TimeoutError if no replies arrive within max_wait.

matched_replier_count.description: Number of repliers currently matched (discovered) by this requester. Use in a polling loop to wait for service discovery.

Replier.description: RPC Replier for receiving requests and sending replies via DDS.

reply_sample_access.description: Reply samples returned by receive_replies() have two key attributes.

attributes.info: SampleInfo with metadata. Check info.valid before accessing data.
attributes.data: The actual reply data (instance of the reply_type class).
